description: K.C.P. Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells sugar and related products in India. The company offers bio-fertilizers, rectified spirit, extra-neutral alcohol, ethanol, surgical sprit, organic manure, anhydrous alcohol, mycorrhiza vam, calcium lactate, and carbon dioxide. It also manufactures liquidsolid separation equipment for industrial and environmental applications; processes urad dal; and provides research services in the areas of agriculture, chemical, and biotechnology. In addition, the company operates a cogeneration plant. It also exports its products. K.C.P. Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Chennai, India.
